2026-2027.summary: National touring data for the week of August 23, 2026 shows divergent momentum across Bushnell's slate: Hell's Kitchen experienced a sharp 62% gross decline with paid capacity collapsing from 94.7% to 50.5%, signaling potential post-summer audience softness, while The Outsiders surged 41% week-over-week to near-capacity (96.5%) and The Great Gatsby posted modest 17% growth. These movements suggest selective rather than broad-market demand weakness.
